text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Bosnian Ministry of Interior suspended Sarajevo's curfew until February 15. During this period security situation in the Federation territory is due to be examined and final decision will be brought after this period.
- Some 25 billion German marks are required to employ 600,000 jobless Bosnian workers, says expert at humanitarian conference in Sarajevo.
- Bosnian and Croat ministries of interior agreed on draft law on new joint federal police forces in all cantons throughout Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation.
